Rejected 2026-07-02. Reconstructing run state by replaying every mutation
since the run began makes resume time grow with run age instead of staying
constant — the opposite of what a resume path should guarantee. See
`int-0002` for why a felt latency cost is treated as a hard constraint rather
than a nice-to-have, and `dec-0060` for the checkpoint-file design adopted
instead on a related but distinct question.

Fixture entry for `internal/enforcer`, reproducing the `dira why daemon`
example in `README.md`: "✗ event sourcing — rejected earlier as dec-0042."
Per the enforcement set (`docs/plan/lanes/E3.md`), a rejected decision is
matched against its own title/subject — a plan proposing event sourcing for
run history conflicts with this entry directly, independent of its
`alternatives`.
